beginPulseRead.temperatureReason: Owned Pulse feed, unread, composer, history and realtime source reads.
beginPulseRead.reason: Preserves the installed physical/default workspace source. Off mode retains the feed and source accessors and uses legacyPulseSchedule for schedule reads. Bounded feed projections retain only fields used by Pulse visibility, subscriptions, filters and composer snapshots. Index construction skips detail comments, attachments and snapshots. It decodes Body and BodyData under per-update transient admission for mention extraction. TestScaleHotPulseGroupUpdateBodyScaling, WireTimestamps, NativeOwnership, BoundsAndInstalledGeneration, WarmReload, ScheduleProjection and HandlerDifferential cover admission, native values, visibility, ordering and cleanup.

legacyPulseSchedule.reason: Off mode copies the pulse feature flag and default schedule, then only the delivery cursors, user schedules and user/team timezones after feature enablement. TestPulseScheduleReadSource and TestScalePulseSummaryWriterSchedulerDifferential cover source selection and compare scheduler output with bounded mode.
